recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-3661; any future changes to allowed order codes should use the terminology source for CodeSystem/list-order or a new tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-3661 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1. It asked to replace the inadequate List.ordered boolean with a coded element that can state what the list order means, resolved as changing List.ordered to List.orderedBy with a value set and definitions.
initial_application: The request was explicitly applied in SVN revision 4816, git commit e1e29f4ad6c14edf8a8ea1000cb53f1b7fc5b2c8, which changed the List spreadsheet from List.ordered boolean to List.orderedBy CodeableConcept/ListOrder, added valueset-list-order.xml, and removed the old ordered boolean example.
additional_context: List is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published issues FHIR-7502 and FHIR-24878 clarified List ordering semantics by adding narrative guidance and List.entry.orderMeaning tied to List.orderedBy. The current ValueSet/list-order delegates to the active terminology.hl7.org CodeSystem/list-order, which contains the original requested codes and definitions plus later additions. A 2023 Zulip thread discussed document/array order for List.orderedBy without revealing a reversal or source conflict.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml already defines List.orderedBy as CodeableConcept with a preferred binding to ValueSet/list-order, source/list/list-notes.xml explains the order semantics, and source search found no remaining List.ordered boolean definition.
